translations.web: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
translations.bsb: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.
translations.kjv: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
translations.asv: And no one hath ascended into heaven, but he that descended out of heaven, even the Son of man, who is in heaven.
